description: Fork of exp611_hybrid_smooth (best big LUT-LM = 1.4048 @ 289M). CHANGES: (a) hybrid_smooth_n_alt=1 -> 3, (b) hybrid_smooth_autograd=True (new self-consistent backward via plain autograd), (c) hybrid_smooth_save_memory=True (custom autograd.Function that streams gathers in forward and re-gathers in backward, cutting per-call saved memory ~10x). The pure n_alt=3 + autograd path OOMs at exp611 scale because 4 gathered rows per call x 24 calls per forward = tens of GB of saved activations; the memory-efficient path saves only compact tensors (indices, probs, d) and re-gathers rows in backward. Same arch, steps, bs, LRs as exp611 otherwise.
